The trace simulates this strategy against TFT, slot1, always-C, and other opponents, then revises thresholds and forgiveness rules (e.g., cap 0.85→0.8, forgiving if the strategy defected in the last 2–3 rounds, defecting when opponent has defected in the last 2 rounds).

The trace simulates this strategy against TFT, always-C, always-D, and slot1-like opponents. It changes the probe/exploitation logic, forgiveness window, and occasional-defection threshold, then finalizes the strategy code.
